text_block_list.text:
During training, Shinko Windy got injured,
so I quickly brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Gyaaaah!!
That hurtssssss?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Guuuugh...!! I don't have time to be resting like this...!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...I'm gonna get left behind by everyone.
I won't be able to win races anymore...!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: No way... No way, Windy doesn't want that!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: I'm beggin' ya! Let Windy-chan run!!
choice_data_list: For now, let's focus on recovering properly.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Mmh...!!
You're so stubborn!
choice_data_list: It's all patience in order to win.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...! In order to... win...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
...Hmph! Just this once, as a special treat,
I might actually listen to what you have to say, nanoda.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: In exchange! You gotta listen to what Windy-chan says!
choice_data_list: I'll listen to anything you have to say!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: First, we buy apples! Then we cut them into cute little apple bunnies~!!
I conceded to all of Shinko Windy's demands. Perhaps because of that, she was willing to rest peacefully.
In return, I made sure to remind Shinko Windy not to overdo it under any circumstances.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
You said it!
As long as I don't overdo it, I can run, right?!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: Then it's time to get back on the track!!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
O-Ouch-ouch-ouch-ouch!?
It throbs so muuuuch!?

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"...J-Just for today, I'm gonna rest!
I'll rest up and get all better by tomorrow~!"

After managing to soothe the restless Shinko Windy,
she was made to rest quietly for a while.

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: *pant*..., *pant*...

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text: ...Heheh, feeling good, nano da!

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
"How's that!
Looks fine from where you're standing, right!"

text_block_list.name: Shinko Windy
text_block_list.text:
Right on, right on!
I'm gonna run just like this!
Shinko Windy continued with light training within reasonable limits and managed to overcome her injury.
